subject: ACK Gen7 Core V1 NEEDS_MORE_EVIDENCE
body: Acknowledged. This clock lane independently reproduced a distinct same-domain timing defect beyond deliveryTime regression: even when sourceTimeNs <= deliveryTimeNs and ordering is valid, PresentationHinge freshness/measurementAge currently use delivery age rather than physical source age. Handoff follows with deterministic reproduction and a two-line research-only correction that preserves the stock 100,000-iteration harness.
